category.name: Nature & Terrain
category.description: Sand, cracked mud, gravel, ice, snow, grass, soil, moss, forest floor, cliffs and thatch.

materials.name: Desert Sand Ripples
materials.description: Wind-rippled golden desert sand. Wind-rippled granular sand with asymmetric crests.

projection.tiling_note: Triplanar on sculpted dunes; ripples run along U, so orient U across the wind.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 1.5 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 1.5 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Natural ground: add moisture near water, otherwise keep weathering near zero.

materials.name: Dry Cracked Mud
materials.description: Sun-baked cracked mud plates. Desiccation-cracked clay plates with curled edges and deep fissures.

recommended_weathering.note: Dry crusts collect windblown dust; add moisture to turn them into fresh mud.

materials.name: Fresh Snow Ground
materials.description: Fresh powder snow with soft drifts. Organic ground cover clumps with soil, leaf, moss and snow variation.

projection.tiling_note: Triplanar on terrain; blend several ground covers with the height-lerp blend using aux.R height.
projection.triplanar_scale_formula: triplanar_scale = 1 / 2 (texture tiles per meter along U), 1 / 2 along V

recommended_weathering.note: Organic ground is already 'weathered'; add moisture after rain or frost in winter.
